card.name: The digit 2 after a leading 2
card.fires_on: The second digit 2 when it follows another 2, as in 22, 225 or 220. It appears inside numbers such as doses, list numbers, volume numbers and table values.

modes.label: Dose numbers
modes.description: A repeated 2 inside a dose amount such as 225 mg.
modes.example: Initiate therapy with propafenone hydrochloride extended-release capsules 2<<2>>5 mg given every 12 hours

modes.label: List or volume numbers
modes.description: The second 2 in item numbers, volume numbers or counts.

modes.label: Table decimals
modes.description: A 2 after a leading 2 or 0.2 in a table of values.

card.plain: It fires on the second 2 of a number that starts with 22, wherever such numbers appear.
